narration: Eight imaginary industries. One fund. Meet FRNT, the Frontier Industries ETF on Meme Street's fictional market. It's a single fund that holds a slice of the imaginary industries. Inside are eight industries, from teleportation to alchemy, with a slice of many companies, all in one price. Traders use it to bet on the whole frontier, without having to pick one company. Its strength is all eight industries in a single trade. The risks? A frontier-wide sell-off, one weak industry dragging the rest, and big news days. On Meme Street, stories like these hit the news wire, and the fund reacts. Trade FRNT at memestreet.net.
